title: P-Aligner: Enabling Pre-Alignment of Language Models via Principled Instruction Synthesis
reasoning: The paper focuses on general preference alignment using the 3H criteria (Helpfulness, Harmlessness, Honesty). While it includes safety and ethical guidelines within its 'Harmlessness' principle for instruction synthesis, it is a technical alignment method and does not specifically benchmark or evaluate religion, faith, or complex ethical frameworks.
